# agentic-drive

Store, sort, and share files and folders.

Keywords: drive,files,folders,storage,upload,sharing,agents,mcp,cli,r2.

- SDK: import { createDrive } from "agentic-drive".
- Remote SDK: import { createClient } from "agentic-drive/client". createClient({ baseUrl, token, fetch? }) has one method for each bearer route and each shared route (list, stat, mkdir, upload, download, move, trash, restore, purge, search, share, createLink, and more). A failed call throws DriveApiError with code and status. It runs in browsers, Workers, and Node 22.
- CLI: agentic-drive ls /.
- MCP: run agentic-drive mcp, then call drive_ls.

## Docs
